basic_details.job_title: GMC Nagpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 21 Assistant Professor, Blood Transfusion Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College, Nagpur (शासकीय वैद्यकीय महाविद्यालय, नागपूर) is filling 21 posts in the Assistant Professor cadre – 15 at Government Medical College, Nagpur and 6 at Government Medical College and Super Speciality Hospital, Nagpur – on a contract, purely temporary basis for 364 days. The application in the prescribed form must be handed in personally at the college office, and the last date for receipt is 25 November 2026 till 5.00 PM. Interviews are on 1 December 2026 at 3.00 PM.

PG degree in the concerned subject with 1 year as Senior Resident or Tutor (details below)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are not sent by post or email. The candidate must submit the self-filled application in the prescribed form, with the proper documents attached, personally (in person) at the office of Government Medical College, Hanuman Nagar, Medical Square, Nagpur-440009. The notice asks for "proper documents" with the application but does not list them item by item; original documents must be produced at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification for these 15 posts (as printed: "As per notification 14.02.2022 & 30.06.2025"): Post graduate degree MD/MS/DNB/OPTH in the concerned subject. Experience of Senior Resident or Tutor of 1 year in the concerned subject in a recognized medical College / institution. Should have completed or be required to undergo the Basic Course in Biomedical Research. Should have completed or be required to undergo the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology from institutions designated by NMC. Educational qualification for these 6 posts (as printed: "As per notification 14.02.2022 & 30.06.2025"): Post graduate degree MD/DM/MCh in the concerned subject. Experience of Senior Resident or Tutor of 1 year in the concerned subject in a recognized medical College / institution. Should have completed or be required to undergo the Basic Course in Biomedical Research. Should have completed or be required to undergo the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology from institutions designated by NMC. The notice says the number of posts may increase or decrease. It does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies. The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted. The appointment is on a contract basis, purely temporary, on a consolidated honorarium, for 364 days. It lasts until the posts are filled through the route prescribed by the government, or until a candidate becomes available through direct recruitment by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission, or by transfer – whichever happens first. Selection is made through the local selection board. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMC Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 vacancies: 15 at Government Medical College, Nagpur and 6 at Government Medical College and Super Speciality Hospital, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GMC Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in person by 25 November 2026 till 5.00 PM, during government office hours.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for GMC Nagpur Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: A post graduate degree MD/MS/DNB/OPTH (GMC Nagpur posts) or MD/DM/MCh (Super Speciality Hospital posts) in the concerned subject, with 1 year as Senior Resident or Tutor, and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology completed or to be undergone.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GMC Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for the open category and 45 years for backward classes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of GMC Nagpur contract Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: A consolidated honorarium on contract basis of Rs. 1,00,000/- is admissible.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for GMC Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application form yourself, attach the proper documents and hand it in personally at the Government Medical College office, Nagpur by 25 November 2026, 5.00 PM; other methods are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. When is the GMC Nagpur Assistant Professor interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 1 December 2026 at 3.00 PM at the Dean Office, Government Medical College, Nagpur, and no separate interview letter will be sent.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GMC Nagpur Assistant Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a purely temporary contract appointment for 364 days, lasting until the posts are filled by the government route, MPSC direct recruitment or transfer, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA or DA be paid for the GMC Nagpur interview?
faq.answer: No, no daily allowance or travel allowance of any kind is admissible for attending the interview.
